questions.solution_html:
• There are loops at a, b, c, and d → (a,a), (b,b), (c,c), (d,d) ∈ R
  • So the relation R is Reflexive ………….1 ½ marks
  • Between a and c there are arrows both ways → (a,c) and (c,a) ∈ R
  • Between a and d there are arrows both ways → (a,d) and (d,a) ∈ R
  • So the relation R is symmetric ………….1 ½ marks
  • (c,a) and (a,d) are in R , But (c,d) is not present
  • So the relation R is not Transitive. ………….2marks
  • So the given relation is not an equivalence relation because it is not transitive
